capabilities: Show the dayGLANCE agenda (calendar, tasks, events, routines) in a sidebar and complete tasks from it
Sync tasks between dayGLANCE and daily notes, chosen folders or tags, and linked project or goal notes
Link notes to dayGLANCE projects and goals, keeping status in dayglance: frontmatter for Dataview
Add selected text or the current line to dayGLANCE as an inbox task with a wikilink back to the note
Pair the vault with a GLANCEvault server and apply dayGLANCE changes to the vault with AES-256-GCM encryption
extras: Free and open source under MIT, with no ads or payments; requires a self-hosted GLANCEvault server (no hosted option and no account with the author); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: dayGLANCE can read and write a vault folder on its own, but a folder alone cannot push planner changes into notes, link notes to projects, or send tasks from Obsidian back to the planner.

relations.evidence: Connects an Obsidian vault to dayGLANCE, a privacy-first day planner.
A self-hosted GLANCEvault server, dayGLANCE's sync server, with dayGLANCE syncing to it.
from your own template if you have one (Templater is supported)

summary: Sidebar bridge to the dayGLANCE planner that shows your agenda and keeps tasks in daily notes, chosen folders and project notes in step.
